cells.quote: Within all applicable studies [11, 23, 60, 73, 74, 76, 78, 83, 86], the ratio proved to increase significantly in participants when performing or training under stressful situations.
cells.note: Systematic-review synthesis of studies conducted in varied surgical educational and performance settings; the study text does not specify participant ages or a common duration.

cells.quote: Previous studies suggest that adopting a student-focused approach to teaching correlates positively with HE teachers’ self-efficacy beliefs [9,10] and positive emotions [11], indicating its potential relevance for their well-being as well.
cells.note: Background association attributed to prior studies; this protocol reports no new data or printed effect size for the association.
